attributes.scope: MWCC GC 1.2.5 family with the per-TU flags in configure.py

subject: compiler:mwcc-gc-1.2.5
value: Retail duplicates stores per branch arm where a ternary would emit one join store (anim-select family), but clamps are nested ternaries with a single join store; check the target join before picking a form. f64-constant selects put the (f32) cast OUTSIDE the ternary for a single frsp. Two-phase idiom: `PF = expr; PF = f(PF);` stores then reloads. Dead stores to address-taken arrays survive (write the dead store when the target shows it). Zero-init position = statement position, not declaration position; a selector local initialized in the final else keeps per-arm li duplication that a decl initializer would merge.
